title: Выделение: It was … who, What I need is …

theory.md: Чтобы выделить главное, фразу перестраивают. **It is / was + выделенное + who / that**: **It was Rory who** took the map. **What + подлежащее + глагол + is**: **What I need is** a rest. По-русски так же выделяют интонацией или словом «именно».

cells: It was Rory who took the map.
What I need is a rest.
What I like is the silence.

theory.md: После It was о людях — **who**, о вещах и обстоятельствах — **that**: It was in the forest **that** I saw him.

examples.es: It was Sam who found the path.
What I want is the truth.
It was in the swamp that we lost the lantern.
examples.ru: Именно на болоте мы потеряли фонарь.

examples.es: What surprised me was the silence.

options: It was Rory who took the map.
It was Rory which took the map.
Was it Rory who took the map.
What I need is a rest.
What I need it is a rest.
That I need is a rest.

exercises.sentence: It was at the station ___ I saw her.
exercises.ru: Именно на вокзале я её увидел.

exercises.sentence: ___ I like about the forest is the smell.

exercises.statement: «It was my sister who called» — правильно.
«What I need it is coffee» — правильно.
